book.cc_aeroworks.page_1:
CC-Aeroworks

Choose one access path:

1. A Computer Control Desk with the direct aeroworks API.

2. An external computer connected to any desk using the peripheral API.
book.cc_aeroworks.page_2:
Controls

Open computer:
Sneak + right-click, empty main hand.

Operate control:
Normal right-click on the module.

Settings:
Wrench a horizontal desk side.
book.cc_aeroworks.page_3:
Multiblock

Same-facing desks connect left and right. Each multiblock needs only one embedded computer.

A second computer desk placed accidentally becomes a normal desk and ejects its computer.
book.cc_aeroworks.page_4:
External computer

local desk = peripheral.find("cc_aeroworks_control_desk")
local desks = desk.getDesks()

One direct connection or Wired Modem to any desk is enough.
book.cc_aeroworks.page_5:
Embedded computer

local desks = aeroworks.getDesks()
local modules = aeroworks.getModules(desks[1].id)

No modem, peripheral.find or peripheral.wrap is required.
book.cc_aeroworks.page_6:
Displays

Text/number: 2 or 3 characters.
Pixels: 7x5 or 11x5.

setDisplayText(...)
setDisplayNumber(...)
setDisplayPixels(...)
clearDisplay(...)
book.cc_aeroworks.page_7:
Combined control

Select Combined in the module screen and capture an activation key.

Lever/Throttle: Mouse Y
Joystick X: Mouse X
Joystick Y: Mouse Y
book.cc_aeroworks.page_8:
Help

Hold W over a Computer Control Desk to open its Ponder explanation.

Inspect errors with:
local n = aeroworks.getNetwork()
print(n.state, n.memberCount)
guide.cc_aeroworks.title: CC-Aeroworks API Documentation
guide.cc_aeroworks.start.title: Choose an access path
guide.cc_aeroworks.start.text: A multiblock can be managed either by exactly one embedded Computer Control Desk or by an external CC:Tweaked computer. An external computer only needs a connection to any loaded desk.
guide.cc_aeroworks.start.controls: Open Ponder: Hold W over a Computer Control Desk in an inventory or recipe viewer.
guide.cc_aeroworks.start.note: Embedded and external computers are alternatives. Multiple external programs may still observe the same peripheral network.
guide.cc_aeroworks.computers.title: Use Computer Control Desks
guide.cc_aeroworks.computers.text: Normal and advanced Computer Control Desks retain the computer ID, label, terminal size and desk modules. The terminal can be opened from any loaded member of the active multiblock.
guide.cc_aeroworks.computers.controls: Terminal: Sneak + right-click with an empty main hand. Control: normal right-click. Settings: Wrench a horizontal desk side.
guide.cc_aeroworks.computers.warning: A multiblock may contain at most one embedded computer. If another is placed accidentally in Survival, a normal desk remains and the additional computer is ejected with its data.
guide.cc_aeroworks.computers.note: In Creative mode a placement which would create a conflict is cancelled to avoid duplicating a computer ID.
guide.cc_aeroworks.network.title: Direct API and peripheral API
guide.cc_aeroworks.network.text: The embedded computer exposes aeroworks globally. An external computer uses cc_aeroworks_control_desk. Both access the connected multiblock but use different method names and events.
guide.cc_aeroworks.network.note: Desk indices start at 1 and may change after rebuilding. Store the stable desk ID returned by getDesks() for persistent targets.
guide.cc_aeroworks.modules.title: Sockets, modules and inputs
guide.cc_aeroworks.modules.text: Sockets are named left, right and big and use indices 0, 1 and 2. Multi-channel modules return tables keyed by channel ID. Removed channels are emitted with nil.
guide.cc_aeroworks.modules.note: Single desk event: cc_aeroworks_desk_input. External multiblock: cc_aeroworks_multiblock_input. Embedded computer: cc_aeroworks_console_input.
guide.cc_aeroworks.displays.title: Text, numbers and pixels
guide.cc_aeroworks.displays.text: Two-digit displays support two characters and 7x5 pixels; three-digit displays support three characters and 11x5 pixels. Text and number methods select text mode, pixel methods select pixel mode.
guide.cc_aeroworks.displays.note: Pixel coordinates start at 1,1 in the upper-left corner. Complete grids contain exactly five strings made from 0 and 1.
guide.cc_aeroworks.controls.title: Controls and settings
guide.cc_aeroworks.controls.text: A normal right-click operates Aeroworks controls. Right-click a horizontal desk side with a Create Wrench to open the control overview. Combined can be selected there for each supported axis.
guide.cc_aeroworks.controls.input: In Combined mode click the centre field, capture a key or mouse button, then look at the module, hold the key and move the mouse.
guide.cc_aeroworks.controls.note: Releasing the key, opening a menu, losing focus or losing the target ends combined control immediately.
guide.cc_aeroworks.errors.title: Network states and diagnosis
guide.cc_aeroworks.errors.text: active means exactly one embedded owner, none means no embedded computer, and conflict means multiple embedded computers. Partially loaded networks and networks over 64 desks are rejected.
guide.cc_aeroworks.errors.warning: Conflicts from old worlds, commands or structure tools remain as a safety state. Normal Survival placement prevents new conflicts automatically.
guide.cc_aeroworks.errors.note: For unexpected behaviour print getNetwork(), getDesks() and desk IDs first. Then verify the socket, module ID and event name.
ponder.cc_aeroworks.computer_control_des: Same-facing desks connect left and right into one multiblock.
One Computer Control Desk manages the entire multiblock.
Sneak and right-click any desk with an empty main hand to open the terminal.
Operate a mounted control with a normal right-click.
Right-click a horizontal desk side with a Wrench to open control settings.
Alternatively, one external computer connected to any desk is enough; no embedded computer is required.
A multiblock may contain only one embedded computer.
If placed accidentally, the new desk becomes normal and its computer is ejected.
